content.text: InstagramLog InSign UpCloseNever miss a post from 5reasonstovisitSign up for Instagram to stay in the loop.Sign upLog inAudio is muted5reasonstovisit•FollowThe Cranberries•Dreams (Sped Up)More options5reasonstovisit Edited•44wDiego Garcia, a remote and secretive island in the Indian Ocean, has long fascinated adventurers with its stunning tropical beauty and unique geopolitical history. Part of the British Indian Ocean Territory, this tiny atoll is situated roughly halfway between Africa and Southeast Asia, but it’s not your average travel destination. Known for its restricted military access, visiting Diego Garcia is no easy feat—but that only adds to its allure. A visit might not be easy, but its unique status makes it one of the world’s most fascinating destinations.
